name: Nebride
title: The slime goddess
species: Shape-shifting slime (usually a foxgirl; also appears as many other forms)
description: Nebride is a Norwegian VTuber and [VRChat](https://vrchat-legends.fandom.com/wiki/VRChat) streamer whose lore casts her as a shape-shifting slime creature, explaining the frequent, often dramatic avatar changes during her broadcasts. She tried VRChat as early as 2017 but became a dedicated full-body streamer after getting a Quest 2 headset in 2020, building a community around high-energy dance streams, horror games, and listener-requested music playlists. She has streamed on both Twitch and Kick, branding herself as 'your favorite shiny vibetuber.'
